rules.statement: In an application for probate of a Last Will, the failure to comply with section 532 of the Civil Procedure Code, which mandates publication in a newspaper that would reach all persons interested in the administration of the deceased's property, renders the order absolute liable to be set aside by the Supreme Court upon an application for revision.
rules.supporting_quote: "In such a case the order absolute for probate is liable to be set aside by the Supreme Court upon an application is revision made by interested parties to intervene in the testamentary proceedings."
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: section 532 of the Civil Procedure Code
